findings.quote: 5.1 If the Recipient or any of its Affiliates is requested or ordered by a court, regulatory body or government agency to disclose any of the Discloser's Confidential Information, the Recipient shall immediately notify the Discloser in writing to the extent legally permissible.
findings.fallback_cited: Notice 'where lawful' and cooperation at the Disclosing Party's cost.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 0.76, breach 0.16, unclear 0.08).

findings.quote: 5.2 The Recipient shall, at its sole cost and expense, exhaust all legal remedies, applications and appeals to resist, stay, limit or challenge such disclosure demand before disclosing any Confidential Information, and shall not provide any documents or testimony unless a final and non-appealable order compelling production has been issued by a court of competent jurisdiction.
findings.draft_redline: The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law, court, regulator or stock exchange. Where legally permitted, it shall give the Discloser prompt notice and, at the Discloser's cost, reasonably cooperate in any effort to resist or obtain confidential treatment for the disclosure.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We cannot agree to exhaust all appeals at our own cost or to wait for a final non-appealable order. We have proposed standard wording requiring notice where lawful and cooperation at the Discloser's cost.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 0.00, breach 1.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 5.3 If disclosure remains strictly compulsory following the exhaustion of such remedies, the Recipient shall disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information that its external legal counsel advises in writing is strictly necessary to satisfy the mandate, and shall use its best efforts to obtain reliable assurances that confidential treatment will be accorded to the disclosed Information.
findings.fallback_cited: Obligation to use reasonable endeavours to obtain confidential treatment, at the Disclosing Party's cost.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 0.81, breach 0.16, unclear 0.03).

6.1 Upon written request from the Discloser, or upon conclusion of the discussions regarding the Purpose, the Recipient shall promptly:
